simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָהַל (H167) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָהַל (ʼâhal) means to tent First listed occurrence: Gen 13 12.

definitions.full: H167. ahal [ אָהַל ] verb denominative tent, move tent from place to place (compare Assyrian â'ilu (?) Dl W No. 4 & Agl ) וַיֶּאֱהַל Gen 13:12 , 18 (J), compare אֹהֶל ישֵׁב (see אֹהֶל ); Pi`el Imperfect יַהֵל (contracted for יְאַהֵל ) pitch one's tent like nomad Isa 13:20 .
